name: Crystal Lee Brown
biography: Crystal Lee Brown is an Emmy® Nominated actress, audition coach and self-tape specialist. She also serves as an on-set Dialogue/Acting Coach for network television. She received a B.A. of Fine Arts from Temple University, where she majored in Sports Journalism and Theater. Her niche as the" hip and witty charmer with an east coast flare" has landed her roles in numerous feature films and television productions.
